scripts.docker:prune: docker compose down -v --rmi all --remove-orphans && docker volume prune -f
scripts.test:unit: bun test --cwd services/games tests/unit && bun test --cwd services/wallets tests/unit
scripts.test:e2e:backend: bun test --cwd services/games tests/e2e && bun test --cwd services/wallets tests/e2e
scripts.test:playwright:install: cd e2e && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
